description: The chart represents the distribution of four categories (N+K+, N-K+, N-K-, and N+K-) across three different levels of difficulty: easy, medium, and hard. Each pie chart has four slices, corresponding to the four categories. In the easy chart, the slices are labeled with percentage values and are colored according to the legend on the right, with N+K+ (teal) at 40.6%, N-K+ (olive) at 45.9%, N-K- (brown) at 10.1%, and N+K- (red) at 3.3%. The medium chart also has four slices, with N+K+ at 44.6%, N-K+ at 44.3%, N+K- at 7.2%, and N-K- at 3.9%. The hard chart has N-K- at 36.8%, N+K+ at 36.2%, N-K- at 20.1%, and N+K- at 7.0%, although the labels are not entirely clear, the colors match the legend. A legend is provided on the right side of the image, indicating the color corresponding to each category. The percentage labels are shown inside each slice. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded in any of the charts. The categories appear to be ordered differently in each chart, with no consistent pattern across the three charts.
